correctness.rationale: For the octahedron each centered vertex ball is exactly singleton, complement of one antipode, or all six vertices. Independent row maximization yields exactly 729 nonnegative averaging matrices. Integer Sylvester tests show the 726 nonexceptional squared singular norms are strictly below 141/100. The other 3 are analyzed by a 2x2 block with squared top eigenvalue (21+6 sqrt(6))/25; orthogonal complement singular squares 1 and 1/25 (three times). The explicit strictly active positive eigenvector proves attainment. Uniqueness of its leading eigenline and strict separation yield every extremizer. The included checker was run against its actual source.

value.rationale: This determines a natural missing strong l2 invariant of the unique simple 4-regular six-vertex graph, a Platonic skeleton and the first three-pair matching-complement graph. The exact constant is strictly larger than the known norm for K6; every maximizer concentrates on an antipodal pair rather than a graph bipartition. The classification is complete for all real inputs and supplies precise structural information beyond an arbitrary finite test; no unproved claim for larger graphs is made.
